nodes.name: Triage Result Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives every newly finalized successful triage result (query, category, priority, routed_queue, confidence, escalated, resolution_notes) from the Streamlit app's optional TRIAGE_N8N_WEBHOOK_URL integration. This node makes zero AI decisions -- it only routes an already-finalized result to downstream business actions. IMPORTANT: n8n's Webhook node wraps the POST JSON body under a top-level 'body' key, so every downstream expression must read $json["body"]["..."], not $json["..."] directly -- verified against a real Streamlit/LangGraph-generated payload.

nodes.name: Escalated?
nodes.notes: Escalation takes precedence: an escalated case is routed here regardless of its priority, so an escalated+high-priority case triggers exactly one notification (this email), never two.

parameters.subject: Human Review Required - Smart Inquiry Triage

nodes.name: Escalation Email (Gmail - configure manually)
nodes.notes: MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED, not done in this repo: (1) set the 'sendTo' field to your recipient address, (2) attach Gmail OAuth2 credentials via the n8n UI's Credentials panel. This file contains no email address, account ID, token, client secret, or credential of any kind -- the node will show as needing credentials until you configure it manually.

nodes.name: High Priority?
nodes.notes: Only reached for non-escalated results (see 'Escalated?' false branch). Reads from $json["body"]["priority"] -- the Webhook node wraps the POST payload under 'body'.
